recent_trades.reasoning: MSFT is a high-quality compounder but trades at a rich multiple. The position is currently 5.01% of the portfolio. We already trimmed MSFT on 9/1 for the same broad reason; this fresh yield spike is a concrete deterioration that justifies a further small trim while retaining a core position.

The position is kept small because cyclicals can be hurt by rising-rate fears even when fundamentals are solid.

Tesla specifically faces a fresh negative catalyst with news of a federal investigation into its Cybercab deployment, which threatens a central growth narrative for the stock.

recent_trades.summary: Initiating a 5% position in Apple on the folding iPhone unveiling catalyst, a concrete near-term product cycle driver.
recent_trades.reasoning: Apple is poised to unveil a folding iPhone — a specific, concrete product catalyst that could re-accelerate the upgrade cycle after several muted cycles. The folding form factor represents Apple's entry into a new hardware category that Samsung has owned. The MacBook lineup shift headline also signals continued innovation cadence. Sentiment is positive (+0.26). AAPL has no prior position in my book and the cash I have can be deployed here. At 5% weight I'm getting meaningful exposure without overconcentrating. The 30-day range shows relative stability (327.07-328.90), suggesting the market hasn't fully priced in the folding iPhone news yet. Energy in the portfolio (COP, EOG) will benefit from diesel headlines, so adding tech diversification via AAPL makes sense.
